divergences.signal_detail_en: Offshore (KWEB/MCHI/CQQQ) 20d equal-weight ret gap vs CSI300: +7.67% (z +2.39); FX-adj gap +8.0% (CNY -0.29%). FX note: gap embeds USDCNY moves — see FX-adj if available. Composition note: basket is tech/internet-tilted (KWEB=internet, CQQQ=tech-heavy) vs CSI 300's financials tilt — gap partly reflects sector rotation, not pure venue sentiment.
divergences.signal_detail_zh: 离岸ETF(KWEB/MCHI/CQQQ) 20日等权收益差 vs 沪深300: +7.67%（z +2.39）；汇率调整后差价 +8.0%（人民币 -0.29%）。注：差值包含人民币汇率影响；篮子偏科技/互联网，与沪深300金融偏重有差异。
divergences.thesis: Offshore China ETF basket (KWEB/MCHI/CQQQ — US-listed offshore listings; ASHR/GXC excluded as they hold A-shares directly) total-return equal-weight gap vs CSI 300. A strongly positive gap (offshore outperforming) while onshore lags = offshore sentiment leading. FX caveat: gap embeds USDCNY. Composition note: basket is tech/internet-tilted (KWEB=internet, CQQQ=tech-heavy) vs CSI 300's financials tilt — gap partly reflects sector rotation, not pure venue sentiment. Hypothesis: sustained offshore leadership tends to attract onshore catch-up over ~3 months.

analogs.method_note: Feature vector: z-scored growth_score and inflation_score (population z over all valid candidate rows) plus one-hot categorical distance for quad, liquidity, and cycle (each mismatched category contributes 1.0 to the Euclidean distance). Weighting is fixed and undifferentiated across the five dimensions. Neighbors selected by greedy Euclidean nearest-neighbor with time-exclusion >=120 calendar days and intra-result diversity >=60 calendar days. Forward paths use PIT-anchored first close strictly after the analog date; off-history windows return null.
analogs.disclaimer_en: DISPLAY ONLY. Historical analogs are descriptive summaries of past regime similarity. They are not signals, forecasts, or recommendations. Past market paths under similar regimes do not predict future returns.
analogs.disclaimer_zh: 仅供展示。历史相似情景是对过去制度相似性的描述性总结，不构成任何信号、预测或投资建议。过去在类似制度下的市场走势不代表未来收益。
